comments.author: Dukester
comments.body: How do I get this title....

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
I believe you have to complete "The Right to Call Yourself a Swordsman" Memorial Album. It consists of four items obtained randomly through four random drop chests. Here they are together:

Armor Award Lorica Hamata
Helmet Award Corinthian Helmet
Greaves Award Legate Greaves
Glove Award Legate Gloves

Those chests can only be bought from Rome's Coliseum, which are sold for Roman Coins only, and the list of chests available for purchase changes weekly.
